$description: The Miragon palette, machine-readable. This file is the ONLY place the validator keeps brand colour values, so the `brand-palette` and `brand-logo-asset` rules cannot drift apart from each other or grow a hand-maintained copy inside a rule. Mirrors the miragon-brand plugin, skill `corporate-design`, `assets/tokens.json`; where the two disagree, tokens.json wins and this file gets pulled back in line.
$rule: brand-review rule B1 (exact palette colours) is a HARD fail, hence category `required` / default `error`.

palette.name: gruen
palette.note: Accent only: key visual, highlights, one word. Never body text on white (1.67:1, fails WCAG AA).

palette.name: schwarz
palette.note: Text on light, monochrome logo. The brand excludes pure #000000.

palette.name: blau-link
palette.note: Derived from blau: links and accent text on white, 6.56:1 (AA). Also tokens.json functional.info.

palette.name: blau-hell
palette.note: Derived from blau: links and accents on dark ground.

palette.name: success
palette.note: STATE only, never a design colour.

palette.name: warning
palette.note: STATE only, never a design colour.

palette.name: danger
palette.note: STATE only, never a design colour.

restricted.name: mesh-hero
restricted.note: tokens.json gradient.mesh-hero. Deliberately outside the base palette and valid ONLY for the animated hero shader and its CSS fallback tokens. #335DE5 and #00E676 are the other two stops and are already palette values.

scan.$note: Repo-relative globs, matched with src/glob.mjs. Only files the toolkit ships (its own styles, components, layouts, mermaid theme) plus the deck's committed Excalidraw diagrams carry author-chosen colour; slide markdown is covered by `no-raw-html` (no hex may appear there at all).
scan.$excludeReason: The logo vectors are official artwork, not authored colour: they are checked byte-for-intent by the `brand-logo-asset` rule below instead.

logo.$note: The official vectors, unaltered. brand-review rule B5: a recoloured or reshaped logo is a hard fail. viewBox values come from tokens.json logo.wordmarkViewBox / logo.kometViewBox; each file carries exactly one fill, declared once in its <style> block.
